evidence.description: Officer responded to an alarm and saw a motion light come on inside
Officer saw a masked, gloved person in dark clothing carrying a bag, who ran back inside
Video shows the person riding a bike into one office, taking cash from a cash box, sawing into a safe, then sawing through a wall into the restaurant
Van stolen from a nearby business and driven through a garage door, causing more than $70,000 in damage
E-bike left behind, wrapped in cloth and other material to hide its outline
Stolen van found the next morning in northeast Rochester with a black jacket on the front seat
Security video nearby appeared to show a person walking away from the van

notes: Police list and arrest list agree on the date. Court-document coverage places the scene in northwest Rochester; the police list gives the same street block as ram-03. On the police arrest list.
